items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: That was the—Henry? Henry Mornad. Mornad, yes. And he fell out of a—slipped out of a bathtub and hit his head.

ctx.x: So, where was she by when she died?

She was 91, I think. 91, wasn't she? Yes, uh-huh. But strong and healthy. She had asthma all of her life, and she weakened her heart. And she was coming through the door one day, and she told her daughter, I need some cool water. And when she came back, my grandmother had slumped. And I think she lived three weeks after that. Yeah. But they were doing everything they could for her. My sister came out in heart condition, honest. Honest, because everybody in my family died in heart. My aunt and her two sons died. I…
